method.source_identity: raw Drive downloads for all 24 tracked retina/ leaves
method.git_index: parsed Drive .git/index DIRC v2 with 241 tracked entries
method.verification: recomputed Git blob SHA1 = sha1('blob <len>\0' + raw bytes) for each tracked retina/ file and compared to index blob identity
method.pinned_github_crosscheck: sampled direct pinned-head GitHub path identities including retina/__init__.py, retina/core.py, retina/vision/__init__.py and retina/vision/ai_detector.py

scope_boundary.rule: Raw-byte identity closure proves the Drive retina/ source snapshot is byte-identical to the tracked Git index identities; it does not by itself establish semantic correctness, test success, or current architectural authority.
